note: Draft questions for the transfer slice. `expected` must be written or confirmed by an SME before a case counts; status=draft cases are excluded from scoring. Each verified case pins the facts/lines it depends on so a regression names the lesson. This public copy keeps two illustrative cases; the real set is client-specific.

cases.q: Which programs change a transfer's status to shipped, and where is the record saved?
cases.expected: LG.XFER.MAINT sets TRANSFER<2> to S when the user ships from the transfer screen and writes the record back through IORELEASE; LG.DOC.READY sets it when a shipment-ready document is completed.

cases.q: Where does a transfer's required date come from?
cases.expected: It is typed on the transfer screen, or set to today's date when a transfer is created from a barcode requisition.
